english: 4. Starting, stopping and a manual change
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Start begins automatic rerolling in that slot. Stop stops that slot.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Start all resumes only inactive slots. Redundant Start all / Stop all shows a message.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Change bonuses requires stopping this slot first. Clicking while it runs only shows a message. Confirming makes one change, even if the targets already match.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Start/Stop ignores double-clicks for 0.5 s. Start waits for the previous result; a blocking popup names the bonus and reason.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: 5. One speed for all three slots
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: The slider sets the gap between the requests of all active slots: 0.05-1 s.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: The step is 0.05 s. The default is 0.05 s; the chosen speed is remembered.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: With 3 items at 0.1 s each item changes about every 0.3 s.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: When one finishes, the others speed up. Server delays can slow them down.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)
client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Start / Stop in the minimap status panel controls all BS slots. Open BS window shows the full window. The notification type is shared by accounts using this client folder.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Choose Popup, PM or Popup + PM next to Presets. Hit notifications work only in the background. PM briefly pauses rerolls until its quest ends.

client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: BS waits for a change to be confirmed before it sends the next request.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: BS waits up to 5 s for confirmation, then retries after about 1 s. Three consecutive unconfirmed attempts stop the slot.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Trade, storage, shops and NPC dialogs pause BS until the blocking window closes. After death, BS waits for revival.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: A manual stop is never resumed by itself.

english: 8. Teleports, channels and where the item is
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: You can change the channel while rerolling. After a channel change or a teleport BS resumes after 5 s.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: It resumes only if the item is still in the remembered inventory slot.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Picking up the item pauses BS. Returning it to the same cell resumes work without resetting the counter.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: Moving stops BS. Right-click the same item in EQ to assign it again. You can also drag it onto its BS slot or return it to its previous EQ slot; then click Start.

english: 9. Buying reroll scrolls in the ItemShop

english: Switching it on asks for your consent and shows the price. It applies to this character only.
notes: client: our windows (companion, Auto Hunt, status lines)

english: A purchase needs free inventory space. If another window blocks it, BS retries every 5 s.
